title: Shared Espanso shortcuts on personal desktops

statements.text: Public machine settings, installation and service have one owner; personal matches have a different private owner.
Use a pinned native ARM64 Wayland build and verify exactly one expansion from direct guest-window input.
An enrolled full apply fast-forwards the private source; previews and unenrolled hosts do not contact it.
Preserve the last working matches on network loss, invalid input, ownership conflict or local divergence; never auto-push.
Adopt reviewed noncredential shortcuts from the Mac as private YAML; every enrolled machine may explicitly publish changes.
Deploy first to the guest, then Mac mini, MBP Omarchy and HP Omarchy, preserving host layouts.
No changes to Git hosting, AI distribution or remote-control keyboard integration.
Input-device access and executable replacements require scoped permissions, private review and recoverable adoption.
